### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, touching **11** documentable anchor(s).

**27** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 21c1f74850eade99b4cb30b86b271d6a9dbd71c7`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `/api/v1/data (route, 50 pages)`, `/api/v1/meta (route, 49 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 21c1f74850eade99b4cb30b86b271d6a9dbd71c7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `21afdaa800c09005db431ab989580144053a1cda` — the merge of head `1a84657c25aa12f010b0174281a43fd51420eb37` into base `21c1f74850eade99b4cb30b86b271d6a9dbd71c7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 21afdaa800c09005db431ab989580144053a1cda && git checkout 21afdaa800c09005db431ab989580144053a1cda
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 21c1f74850eade99b4cb30b86b271d6a9dbd71c7 1a84657c25aa12f010b0174281a43fd51420eb37 && git checkout -B drift-repro 21c1f74850eade99b4cb30b86b271d6a9dbd71c7 && git merge --no-ff 1a84657c25aa12f010b0174281a43fd51420eb37

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 21c1f74850eade99b4cb30b86b271d6a9dbd71c7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 21c1f74850eade99b4cb30b86b271d6a9dbd71c7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1a84657c25aa12f010b0174281a43fd51420eb37`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .changeset/30147-get-discovery-facet.md, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs, scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-host.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/discovery-version.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-services.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/plugin.ts, packages/rest/src/discovery-search-capability-agreement.test.ts, scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, #30975

Round 1 was judged at `56dbba9841`; Round 2 below carries it to the head named above.

Read: `git diff origin/main...refs/review/pr-31177` (origin/main `21c1f74850`, merge base `56baf78e0c`), the three per-commit diffs (`43df6766ff`, `4a2e27e428`, `e87a512b0e`) and the merge `56dbba9841`; card #30147 body and all 20 comments (6686885545, ruling 6687801899, 6690277174, 6690327117, 6708253429, 6709547182 among them); PR #30954 (merged as `26f571911c`) and its changeset; #30975; the head's check-runs. Nothing built, tested or re-run; the codemod's `--verify` was not re-run (read-only), so its byte proof is judged by reading, below.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. Behaviour preserved — holds.**
- Moved body: main's `getDiscovery` body (protocol.ts 2525–2985 on main) and the facet's body (protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts 146–603 at head) differ in exactly four lines: `this.getServicesRegistry` ×2 → `host.getServicesRegistry`, `this.engine` ×2 → `host.engine` (the E1 closed set), and `typeof this.searchAll === 'function'` → `typeof searchAllOnInstance === 'function'`. No other byte of the body changed, so the services map, routes, capability flags and their key order are main's.
- `host.engine` and `host.getServicesRegistry` are getters in the class's static host factory (protocol.ts 1227, 1249) that read the instance field at call time; `protocol-host.ts` is untouched. Calling `host.getServicesRegistry()` rebinds `this` from the instance to the host, but the only production caller passes an arrow (`plugin.ts` 249–251), and three facets on main already call it this way (protocol-class-head.ts 87, protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts 549, protocol-meta-list-reads.ts 582).
- `searchAll`: the stub's argument `this.searchAll` is a property read on the instance at each call. An own-property shadow (the test's `Object.defineProperty(protocol, 'searchAll', { value: undefined })`, line 104), a subclass override or a prototype replacement is seen exactly as main's in-body read saw it. The facet only applies `typeof`, so passing the method unbound loses nothing. main's body has no `await` before the probe, so reading `searchAll` at stub entry instead of mid-body observes the same state. This is the property `discovery-search-capability-agreement` pins; the host-closure route the gate row warned about is not taken.
- Stub: the signature is byte-identical to main's (51 lines compared, `async` kept, the written return type with its `@deprecated` key docblock), and `this` is the instance. A throw in the stub still becomes a rejection.
- Imports: the 15 bindings pruned from protocol.ts have zero remaining uses there. Each is used in the facet body and imported by the facet. The new facet imports (`discovery-version.ts`, `protocol-discovery-services.ts`) do not import `protocol.ts`, so no cycle is added.
- No by-path reader of the moved text exists: the auth-families pins, transactional-batch honesty, openapi and conformance tests do not read source, and no script reads `getDiscovery` out of `protocol.ts`.

**2. Codemod honesty — holds, by reading.**
- `43df6766ff` (X) changes exactly two lines of `protocol.ts`: the parameter `searchAllOnInstance: unknown` and the probe.
- `4a2e27e428` has the members pass's E1 shape and nothing else. protocol.ts: four import hunks, plus the body replaced by the standard `[#29985 codemod]` marker and `return ProtocolDiscoveryAndBasesFacet.getDiscovery(protocolHost(this), searchAllOnInstance)`. Facet: header list gains `getDiscovery`, the import block is added, and a `/** The body of … */` static carries X's body under the E1 rewrites. These are the same marker and docblock forms as the `getProjectId` sibling and #30954's E1 moves. A byte re-run was not possible here; the body diff above is the closed set and nothing more.
- `e87a512b0e` touches only what the recipe names (6686885545 `phase_3b`, 6690327117). In protocol.ts it restores main's signature and hands in `this.searchAll`; it also adds a two-line why-comment, which is benign. The facet is untouched. It also carries ruling 6687801899's registry edits and the house-rule changeset.
- X leaves nothing unintended in the net diff. The public signature is main's again, and the facet parameter is the intended carrier. The merge `56dbba9841` touches none of the four PR files.

**3. Registry against ruling 6687801899 — holds.**
- The getDiscovery row is deleted.
- Exactly three rows keep `#30147`: `triggerAutomation`, sql-driver `get supports` and `static DIALECT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`. Each reason is prefixed `accepted terminal exception (ruling 6687801899):`, with the written reason kept after the prefix. Keeping the `card` is forced: the gate refuses any `card` that is not `#N` (check-facade-delegation-only.mjs 731).
- Exactly the four engine.ts rows re-point to #30975, with their reasons unchanged. #30975 is open, owns exactly these four rows, and sits `pm:blocked` behind #30747.
- No other row changed.
- Against current main: #31151 deleted the ObjectQL `constructor` row. A two-dot diff still shows that row only because the branch predates #31151. `git merge-tree` of origin/main with the head is clean, and the merged registry has 15 exceptions with no constructor row resurrected: #30147 ×3, #30975 ×4, the rest unchanged.
- `triggerAutomation`'s doubled label is **not worth a should-fix**. The ruling says each row "keeps the reason already written on it". The inner `accepted exception (#30147 phase 3):` is that written reason and is still historically true. The outer label adds "terminal" and the ruling. Trimming it would edit a reason the ruling said to keep.

**4. Public surface — unchanged, by reading.** `getDiscovery` keeps its written return type on the class. `ProtocolDiscoveryAndBasesFacet` is not exported from the package entry (the `exports` map is `.` only, and only protocol.ts imports the facet), and no public type gained or lost a member. The changeset is `'@objectstack/metadata-protocol': patch` with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, which is the house rule: kind `none` takes `patch`, and the built JS of a released package changes. It matches #30954's changeset shape.

**5. Landing.**
- The body carries `Fixes #30147` and `Clause-②: no`, and the changeset repeats both declaration lines.
- The body matches the tree at head: four files, the three commits as described, the registry edits as listed, and engine.ts and sql-driver.ts untouched (absent from the diff).
- The PR is not governed. None of the four paths matches a `GOVERNED_SURFACES` row, and the Governed Surface Queue Guard is green.
- Ruling 6687801899 says the card closes when this PR lands, and it does.

**Check-runs at head (polled 2026-11-07T16:12Z):**
- **Green:** Lint & Repo Gates; all Lint jobs, including CI, release & engine gates, ESLint, docs & code guards, repo & tooling gates, PM dispatch-gates and the scoped jobs; Type Check · source gates and · debt ledger; Check Changeset; Check PR Size; Governed Surface Queue Guard; PR-body guards; Dogfood Regression Gate; Live E2E UI; Test UI; Plan Test Core shards; Auto Label; Flag docs; filter.
- **Still in progress:** Build Core, Test Core 1/8–8/8, Type Check · workspace and · consumer gates. Those verdicts are not yet in, and landing waits on them in any case.

**Must-fix:** none.

**Should-fix:**
- S1 (protocol.ts 13–14): the codemod pruned `import { resolveDiscoveryVersion }` but left its two-line comment. "[commit 376c70f98] The derived `version` this file's `getDiscovery()` serves…" now annotates the `MetadataHostEngine` import and misstates where the body lives. Delete it, or move it above the facet's `resolveDiscoveryVersion` import, as one more hand edit.
- S2 (scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs, `## Exceptions — named, carded, and dead once their card lands`): after this PR lands, three rows cite a card that is closed and will never move them. The gate's prose still says every row names "the card that will move it" (ruling 6624345766 item 3). Add one sentence naming the accepted-terminal class and ruling 6687801899, so the rule and its gate read as one. This can be done here or as a follow-up.
- S3 (PR body): "17 to 16 exceptions" and the two-minute check's expected `16 named exception(s)` are true at merge base `56baf78e0c`. On current main (after #31151) the landed tree prints 15. Refresh the line, or note it.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: a private body moves, the built JS changes, and the public `.d.ts` is unchanged. `Metadata-protocol: none`; no other package publishes a change. `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` is repo tooling and is not published.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not governed, not Tier H or S, no spec or schema path, no ADR, no skills.
- No narrowing: `Clause-②: no`, with no arm.
- Not touched: `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (serial behind #30747 via #30975) and `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`.
- No test file changed, and no `ui/` impact.

### ④ Design judgment

**The move holds against the code it cites and its scenario.** The hazard the registry row recorded was real: a host entry forwards a method through a closure that is always a function, so `capabilities.search` would always read true. The PR does not route the probe through the host. The class reads the member on the instance, the one place main read it, and hands the value to a facet that only asks `typeof`. That is the smallest deviation from the E1 form that keeps `capabilities.search` and the `/search` route answering one predicate (#7541). It also leaves `host-split.mjs`'s refusal of a method read as a value intact, so no general rule was loosened for one member.

**The registry edits implement ruling 6687801899 as written.** The three terminal rows are justified on their own reasons: a one-statement facet, a public declaration change, and a class-evaluation-order hazard. #30975 holds the engine rows with its plan.

The should-fix items are hygiene. None changes what the code does.

### Round 2 delta (`56dbba9841` → `1a84657c25`)

Read: `git diff 56dbba9841..1a84657c25`, the non-merge commit `2bb03299ef`, the merge `1a84657c25` (parents `2bb03299ef` and `21c1f74850`), dev delta report 6710190320, the live PR body, and the check-runs on the new head.

1. **S1–S3 are resolved.**
   - **S1:** the commit-376c70f98 comment is deleted from protocol.ts and now sits directly above the facet's `import { resolveDiscoveryVersion }`, reworded "this facet's `getDiscovery()`".
   - **S2:** one sentence was added to the gate header's Exceptions section.
   - **S3:** main `21c1f74850` is merged in. The live PR body now reads "16 to 15 exceptions, on `main` after #31151" and expects `15 named exception(s)` at `1a84657c25`. The seat patched the body; the dev's report says the dev deliberately did not.
2. **The S2 sentence is accurate against the gate's logic.**
   - It describes a convention and claims no check. The gate never reads card state or reason text. It requires only a `#N` card (line 731) and, if present, a non-empty reason.
   - So a terminal row citing a closed #30147 stays green, as the sentence says. The stale-member rule (a row on a member that is already a delegation is red) still applies to it.
   - The three #30147 rows do open their `reason` with the ruling, as the sentence says.
   - Nit, not a finding: the section heading still reads "dead once their card lands". The sentence beneath it qualifies the heading.
3. **The merge conflicts with nothing.**
   - `1a84657c25`'s tree is byte-identical to a clean `git merge-tree` of `2bb03299ef` with `21c1f74850` (both `c5d62c59fa`), so nothing was resolved by hand.
   - The registry now has 15 exceptions: #30020 ×8, #30147 ×3, #30975 ×4. The ObjectQL constructor row #31151 deleted stays deleted.
   - Against `21c1f74850`, the registry diff is exactly this PR's 20 lines.
   - main has since moved to `620b6e6d40`. Those five commits touch none of this PR's files, and the head merges with them cleanly.
4. **Nothing else changed.** Between the two heads, the PR's own files differ only by `2bb03299ef`: +2/−2 comment lines in metadata-protocol and +4/−1 comment lines in the gate header. The registry change in that span is the constructor-row deletion from main. Everything else in the span is main's, unchanged. The net PR diff is now 5 files, +560/−482. No code, signature, registry row or changeset line changed this round, so Round 1's findings ①–④ stand.

**Check-runs at `1a84657c25` (polled 2026-11-07T16:54Z):**
- **Green:** Build Core; Test Core 1/8–8/8 and the Test Core rollup; TypeScript Type Check and Type Check · workspace, consumer gates, source gates and debt ledger; every Lint job, including CI, release & engine gates, where the facade gate runs; Governed Surface Queue Guard; both PR-body guards runs; Dogfood Regression Gate; Live E2E UI; Test UI; Check PR Size; one Check Changeset run.
- **In progress:** a second Check Changeset run, most likely started by the body edit.

**Must-fix:** none. **Should-fix:** none open; S1, S2 and S3 are resolved.

席位意见：可以落地。行为不变的证据完整，包括函数体逐行对照、公开类型逐字节一致、反向对照。第一轮的 3 项应改已在第 2 轮全部修好，增量复审通过。
